verdict.rationale: Cline Kanban documents per-card isolated git worktrees with auto-commit, and the agent can run arbitrary terminal commands, which could include git operations. The evidence shows no dedicated commit-message authoring, explicit branch-creation workflow, or pull-request opening; git use beyond Kanban auto-commit is only implied by general command execution. Missing for 10: documented commit-message generation, explicit branch creation, PR creation/opening, independent hands-on corroboration of git workflows.
